title: eSIM QR code will not scan or activate
body:
# eSIM QR code will not scan or activate

## Symptoms
Customers typically say things like:
- The eSIM QR code is not working.
- I cannot activate my eSIM, the QR code will not scan.
- My phone says the eSIM cannot be added.

## Likely cause
The eSIM profile was already downloaded once or the QR code expired, so the phone refuses to install it.

## Resolution steps
1. Check the eSIM profile status to see whether it was already downloaded or has expired.
2. Check that the phone supports eSIM and is not locked to another network.
3. Release the old profile and issue a new eSIM QR code.
4. Ask the customer to connect to Wi-Fi and scan the new code.
5. Confirm that the eSIM shows as active and make a test call.

## When to escalate
Escalate to the eSIM platform team if a new profile also fails to download.

title: Transfer eSIM to a new phone
body:
# Transfer eSIM to a new phone

## Symptoms
Customers typically say things like:
- I got a new phone and need to move my eSIM to it.
- How do I transfer my eSIM to another phone?
- My eSIM did not move over when I changed phones.

## Likely cause
An eSIM cannot be moved like a plastic SIM. A new profile has to be issued for the new phone.

## Resolution steps
1. Verify the customer's identity before any SIM change.
2. Check that the new phone supports eSIM.
3. Issue a new eSIM profile for the new phone, which deactivates the old one.
4. Send the new QR code and guide the customer to install it over Wi-Fi.
5. Ask the customer to delete the old eSIM profile from the old phone.

## When to escalate
Escalate to the eSIM platform team if the new profile cannot be issued.

title: Suspected SIM swap fraud
body:
# Suspected SIM swap fraud

## Symptoms
Customers typically say things like:
- My phone suddenly lost service and I got a message about a SIM change I did not request.
- Someone has swapped my SIM without my permission.
- I think I am a victim of SIM swap fraud.

## Likely cause
Someone requested a replacement SIM for the customer's number without permission, taking over the number.

## Resolution steps
1. Verify the customer's identity with the enhanced security checks.
2. Block the fraudulent SIM immediately.
3. Restore the number to a new SIM or eSIM that the customer holds.
4. Add a SIM-change lock and a new account PIN.
5. Advise the customer to contact their bank and report the fraud.

## When to escalate
Always escalate to the fraud team and log a security incident.

title: Phishing text message pretending to be from the provider
body:
# Phishing text message pretending to be from the provider

## Symptoms
Customers typically say things like:
- I got a text saying my bill is unpaid with a link, is it real?
- I received a suspicious message asking me to update my payment details.
- Someone sent me a text pretending to be from you.

## Likely cause
Scammers send texts that look like they are from the provider to steal login or payment details.

## Resolution steps
1. Confirm that the message did not come from us and tell the customer not to click the link.
2. If the customer entered details, reset the account password and PIN immediately.
3. Check the account for recent changes or orders the customer did not make.
4. Ask the customer to forward the message to the spam reporting number.
5. Advise the customer to contact their bank if card details were entered.

## When to escalate
Escalate to the fraud team if the account shows changes the customer did not make.
